name: Gentle Dot
author: kattsushi
description: Native Omarchy bar panel for Gentle Dot: chat with a local or remote Gentle Dot daemon, no WebKit.

barWidget.description: One bar dot showing the assistant's state and a native chat panel for the Gentle Dot daemon.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify about replies, asks and connection outages while the panel is hidden.

schema.label: Notification sound
schema.description: Play a system sound with each notification, except during Do Not Disturb.

schema.label: Send dictation when I stop
schema.description: Send the transcript as soon as recording stops instead of placing it in the composer.

schema.label: Panel opacity
schema.description: Background opacity of the chat panel and its detached window; text stays opaque.

schema.label: Avatar sleeps after (minutes)
schema.description: The avatar falls asleep after this many minutes without activity; any activity wakes it. 0 keeps it awake.

schema.label: Server URL
schema.description: WebSocket URL of the Gentle Dot daemon. Use wss://host/ws for a remote daemon.

schema.label: Token file
schema.description: The token is read from this file on every connect, never stored in shell.json.

schema.label: Node executable
schema.description: Node.js 22 or newer, used to run the bundled WebSocket bridge.
